scope.pilot_context: Only five total products are expected to enter the frozen pilot after parent reconciliation and selection.
scope.intent: Retailer-specialist Phase-1 candidate pool for later live catalog matching, GTIN ownership checks, and pilot prioritization.

methodology: Used current observable German retailer search/PDP renderings from dm, Rossmann, Mueller, and selected official/brand pages when retailer coverage was thin.

Treated multi-retailer presence, category listing order, in-stock or delivery wording, review counts, sponsored/listing prominence, and exact PDP availability as popularity or visibility proxies only.
Excluded exact products that were readily discoverable as currently active in data/scanner-catalog-coverage/2026-08-26/live-baseline.json or current launch enrichment artifacts.

Preserved lane=new_candidate on every row while updating per-row reconciliation_status after live active baseline, global identifier ownership, open-submission overlap, and strict category-fit triage.
Captured canonical GTIN-14 only where a retailer/official source visibly exposed a GTIN/EAN-like product code, and only after checksum validation.
content_fingerprint_algorithm: sha256 of stable JSON excluding content_fingerprint

source_quality_notes.dry_shampoo: Rossmann category/PDP evidence was strongest: many exact rows exposed size, price, review counts, and several visible GTINs. dm and Mueller added cross-retailer support for Batiste and category breadth.
source_quality_notes.heat_protectant: dm category evidence exposed 18 products and strong review counts; Rossmann and Mueller confirmed several non-active exact candidates. Some heat-protectant-adjacent leave-in/styling sprays need category-contract reconciliation before import.
source_quality_notes.deep_cleansing_shampoo: The strict Tiefenreinigung/Deep Cleansing shelf is materially thinner than dry shampoo or heat protectant. Ten rows are possible only by including clarifying, detox, anti-residue, and oil-control shampoo candidates with explicit unresolved category-fit blockers.
source_quality_notes.scalp_care: Rossmann and Mueller have enough scalp tonics/serums/oils for a ten-row pool. Many carry density or hair-loss-adjacent marketing, so later product copy must stay cosmetic and medically conservative.
source_quality_notes.bondbuilder: The mass-retail bond-repair shelf has enough exact products for ten candidates only if leave-in, mask, pre-shampoo, spray-conditioner, and bonding-oil formats are all held for later category-fit review. Shampoo/conditioner rows were deliberately deprioritized except where retailer visibility was unusually strong.

explicit_blockers.blocker: Five confirmed-new rows fit the current reset-focus contract; four rows remain ambiguous holds and Herbal Essences Tiefenreinigung & Glanz is an existing live product match by GTIN.

Only two confirmed-new rows responsibly fit strict standalone specialized bond treatment. The broader ten-row market pool is mostly masks, oils, leave-ins, or spray conditioners with bond/Plex marketing and should not be used to pad Phase1B.

Many high-visibility scalp products use hair-loss/density/growth marketing. Any later Chaarlie copy or classification must avoid unreviewed medical claims; scalp-care-009 remains an oil-vs-scalp ambiguous hold.
